<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="softBrand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".22"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".16"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Underlying app screen -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".18"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="26" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <rect x="319" y="19" width="3" height="7" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="324" y="16" width="3" height="10" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="329" y="13" width="3" height="13" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="334" y="10" width="3" height="16" rx="1"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="21" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="21" x2="352" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="15" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="17" width="14" height="7" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="382" y="19" width="2" height="4" rx="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Background header -->
  <text x="24" y="78" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
  <circle cx="348" cy="66" r="19" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".25"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="61" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="348" cy="73" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="66" r="19" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Background profile card -->
  <rect x="23" y="106" width="344" height="510" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity=".14"/>
  <rect x="20" y="102" width="344" height="510" rx="20" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <rect x="20" y="102" width="344" height="338" rx="20" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="292" cy="164" r="7" fill="#EFC54D"/>
  <polygon points="70,385 154,285 205,345 252,294 344,404 344,440 20,440 20,405" fill="#7D8490"/>
  <circle cx="284" cy="181" r="32" fill="#F5F7FA" opacity=".6"/>
  <circle cx="284" cy="181" r="13" fill="#939393"/>
  <ellipse cx="284" cy="207" rx="24" ry="13" fill="#939393"/>
  <rect x="40" y="462" width="92" height="11" rx="5" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".55"/>
  <rect x="40" y="484" width="210" height="8" rx="4" fill="#939393" opacity=".65"/>
  <rect x="40" y="502" width="175" height="8" rx="4" fill="#939393" opacity=".65"/>
  <circle cx="319" cy="536" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="311" y1="536" x2="327" y2="536" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="319" y1="528" x2="319" y2="544" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Background action row -->
  <circle cx="96" cy="671" r="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="671" r="34" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <circle cx="294" cy="671" r="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="86" y1="671" x2="106" y2="671" stroke="#C42936" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="187" y1="671" x2="203" y2="671" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="195" y1="663" x2="195" y2="679" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="294,657 298,668 310,668 300,675 304,687 294,680 284,687 288,675 278,668 290,668" fill="#EFC54D"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="752" width="390" height="92" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".96"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="752" x2="390" y2="752" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g fill="#939393" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2">
    <polygon points="45,774 57,764 69,774 69,789 45,789"/>
    <rect x="126" y="768" width="20" height="20" rx="10" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="136" cy="777" r="4" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="775" r="8" fill="none"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="781" x2="227" y2="788"/>
    <rect x="295" y="765" width="19" height="20" rx="4" fill="none"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="771" x2="309" y2="771"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="777" x2="309" y2="777"/>
  </g>
  <text x="57" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#4A4A4A">DISCOVER</text>
  <text x="136" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#4A4A4A">LIKES</text>
  <text x="220" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#4A4A4A">MATCHES</text>
  <text x="304" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#4A4A4A">PROFILE</text>

  <!-- Modal dim layer -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".56"/>

  <!-- Verification modal shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="25" y="192" width="340" height="448" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity=".22"/>
  <rect x="27" y="188" width="336" height="448" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- Badge icon -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="246" r="42" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <path d="M195 216 L220 225 L217 249 C214 266 203 276 195 281 C187 276 176 266 173 249 L170 225 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".98"/>
  <path d="M184 247 L192 255 L207 238" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M195 218 L195 279" fill="none" stroke="#FF7854" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".28"/>

  <!-- Modal copy -->
  <text x="195" y="322" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Verify your profile</text>
  <text x="195" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#939393">Show matches that you’re really you.</text>

  <!-- Instruction rows -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="397" r="14" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <text x="68" y="402" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#EA5D6B">1</text>
  <text x="94" y="394" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Take a clear selfie</text>
  <text x="94" y="413" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Use good lighting and face the camera.</text>

  <line x1="52" y1="435" x2="338" y2="435" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="68" cy="466" r="14" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <text x="68" y="471" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#EA5D6B">2</text>
  <text x="94" y="463" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Follow the pose</text>
  <text x="94" y="482" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Match the example shown on screen.</text>

  <line x1="52" y1="504" x2="338" y2="504" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="68" cy="535" r="14" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <text x="68" y="540" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#EA5D6B">3</text>
  <text x="94" y="532" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Get your verification badge</text>
  <text x="94" y="551" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Your photos are reviewed securely.</text>

  <!-- Modal buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="52" y="570" width="286" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="195" y="598" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">NEXT</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="52" y="620" width="286" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="646" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">CANCEL</text>
  </g>
</svg>
